## Overview

This document pairs each sentinel site with the **Division Provinciale de la
Santé (DPS)** that oversees it, and gives both ends of every pair a
coordinate. It is the input to the question *how accessible is each sentinel
site from its DPS office?*

The work has two point sets and one pairs table:

| Piece | Source | Built by |
|-------|--------|----------|
| Sentinel sites | `../output/drc_sentinel_sites_geocoded.csv` | `drc-geocoding-workflow.qmd` |
| DPS headquarters | `../input/drc_dps_26.csv` | this document |
| Pairs | `../input/drc_dps_site_pairs.csv` (`network, dps, sentinel_site`) | this document |

Sentinel sites are **not** geocoded again here. This document uses the
reviewed output of the sentinel workflow, including its manual overrides.

### How the DPS points are found

Each DPS is geocoded with the same quality gate as the sentinel sites, through
its own query ladder:

1. The office itself: `Division Provinciale de la Sante <province>`, pinned to the province
2. The chef-lieu town, pinned to the province
3. The chef-lieu, province and country as free text
4. The chef-lieu alone, restricted to the country

Every rung's result is matched against the **chef-lieu name**. So an office
result in the wrong town is refused by the gate. What the gate cannot do is tell
the DPS office from another building in the right town, because the Geocoding
API returns no establishment name. **Every establishment result therefore goes
to review**, however high its confidence. To confirm one, pin it in
`../input/dps_manual_overrides.csv`.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: load-libraries
#| eval: true

library(tidyverse)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(leaflet)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(knitr)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = knitr::is_html_output())

source("config.R")
source("geocode-functions.R")
source("pairs-functions.R")

dir.create(paths$output, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

The key is read from `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` and is never printed or written. It
is needed even when every response comes from the cache.

```{r}
#| label: api-key-check
#| eval: true

if (!nzchar(Sys.getenv("GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY"))) {
  stop("GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is not set. Export it before rendering this document.")
}
cat("Google Maps API key detected.\n")
```

## Inputs

### DPS headquarters

`province` is the post-2015 province that the DPS seat lies in. The gate
checks it. `chef_lieu` is the town the office is in, and it is the name that
every candidate is matched against.

```{r}
#| label: dps-input
#| eval: true

dps <- read.csv(paths$dps_input, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  ensure_site_id(dps_profile) |>
  distinct(dps_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

validate_provinces(dps)
cat("DPS headquarters:", nrow(dps), "| provinces:", length(unique(dps$province)), "\n")

dps |>
  select(dps_id, dps, province, chef_lieu) |>
  kable(caption = "DPS headquarters to geocode")
```

### Pairs and sentinel sites

```{r}
#| label: pairs-input
#| eval: true

pairs_in <- read.csv(paths$pairs, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                     colClasses = c(network = "character"))

sites_path <- file.path(paths$output, "drc_sentinel_sites_geocoded.csv")
if (!file.exists(sites_path)) {
  stop("Sentinel site coordinates not found at ", sites_path,
       ". Render drc-geocoding-workflow.qmd first.")
}
sites <- read.csv(sites_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

pairs_in |>
  count(network, name = "pairs") |>
  kable(caption = "Pairs by network")

sites |>
  count(confidence, name = "sites") |>
  kable(caption = "Sentinel site coordinates by confidence")
```

## Geocoding the DPS Headquarters

### Query ladder

```{r}
#| label: dps-ladder-example
#| eval: true

build_query_variants("Kananga", "Kasaï-Central", ladder = ladders$dps) |>
  kable(caption = "DPS query ladder, for DPS Kasaï-Central")
```

### Processing loop

```{r}
#| label: dps-processing-loop
#| eval: true

n_cached <- cache_load()
cat("Cached responses available:", n_cached, "\n\n")

results <- list()
audits  <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(dps))) {
  row <- dps[i, ]
  out <- geocode_site(
    site_id  = row$dps_id,
    site     = row$chef_lieu,
    province = row$province,
    ladder   = ladders$dps
  )
  results[[i]] <- out$result
  audits[[i]]  <- out$audit

  cat(sprintf("[%2d/%2d] %-20s %-12s -> %-7s (rung %s)\n",
              i, nrow(dps), row$dps, row$chef_lieu, out$result$confidence,
              ifelse(is.na(out$result$resolved_at_rung), "-",
                     out$result$resolved_at_rung)))
}

dps_geocoded   <- bind_rows(results) |> rename(dps_id = site_id)
dps_candidates <- bind_rows(audits)  |> rename(dps_id = site_id)

cache_save()
cat("\nAPI calls made:", .geocode_cache$calls,
    "| served from cache:", .geocode_cache$hits, "\n")
```

### Manual overrides and review

A row goes to review if any of these is true:

- It was not resolved at high confidence.
- It resolved to anything other than a town or neighbourhood centroid, unless it
  was pinned by hand. For example, a building that may or may not be the DPS
  office.

```{r}
#| label: dps-overrides-review
#| eval: true

dps_geocoded <- apply_manual_overrides(dps_geocoded, paths$dps_overrides,
                                       id_col = "dps_id") |>
  mutate(point_basis = if_else(geocode_status == "manual", "manual",
                               point_basis(matched_types)))

dps_final <- dps |>
  left_join(dps_geocoded, by = "dps_id") |>
  mutate(
    review_reason = case_when(
      confidence == "failed"                     ~ "no acceptable candidate",
      confidence == "manual"                     ~ NA_character_,
      point_basis == "establishment"             ~ "building in the right town: confirm it is the DPS office",
      point_basis == "other"                     ~ "resolved to a street or other non-settlement",
      confidence != "high"                       ~ paste0(
        confidence, " confidence, rung ", resolved_at_rung,
        if_else(coalesce(quality_flags, "") != "", paste0(": ", quality_flags), "")
      ),
      TRUE                                       ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

dps_review <- dps_final |> filter(!is.na(review_reason))

write.csv(dps_final, file.path(paths$output, "drc_dps_geocoded.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(dps_candidates, file.path(paths$output, "drc_dps_candidates.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(dps_review, file.path(paths$output, "drc_dps_review.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("Manual overrides applied:", sum(dps_final$confidence == "manual"), "\n")
cat("Review queue:", nrow(dps_review), "of", nrow(dps_final), "DPS\n")

dps_final |>
  count(point_basis, confidence, name = "dps") |>
  kable(caption = "DPS coordinates by basis and confidence")

dps_final |>
  select(dps, chef_lieu, resolved_at_rung, confidence, point_basis, matched_address) |>
  kable(caption = "DPS geocoding results")
```

```{r}
#| label: dps-review-table
#| eval: true

if (nrow(dps_review) > 0) {
  dps_review |>
    select(dps, chef_lieu, point_basis, confidence, matched_address, review_reason) |>
    kable(caption = "DPS review queue")
} else {
  cat("Nothing to review.\n")
}
```

## Pairs

`straight_line_km` is a great-circle distance, not a travel distance. It is here
to catch blunders and to show which pairs are **co-located**, meaning under
1 km apart. That usually means the sentinel site is in the DPS town itself, and
both ends were resolved to the same town centroid.

```{r}
#| label: build-pairs
#| eval: true

od <- build_pairs(pairs_in, dps_final, sites)

write.csv(od, file.path(paths$output, "drc_dps_site_pairs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Pairs saved to: output/drc_dps_site_pairs.csv\n")

od |>
  group_by(network) |>
  summarise(
    pairs              = n(),
    complete           = sum(complete),
    co_located         = sum(co_located),
    dps_establishment  = sum(dps_basis == "establishment", na.rm = TRUE),
    dps_settlement     = sum(dps_basis == "settlement", na.rm = TRUE),
    dps_manual         = sum(dps_basis == "manual", na.rm = TRUE),
    province_mismatch  = sum(province_mismatch)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Pairs by network")
```

### Incomplete pairs

```{r}
#| label: incomplete-pairs
#| eval: true

incomplete <- od |> filter(!complete)
if (nrow(incomplete) > 0) {
  incomplete |>
    select(network, dps, sentinel_site, dps_confidence, site_confidence) |>
    kable(caption = "Pairs missing a coordinate at one end")
} else {
  cat("Every pair has coordinates at both ends.\n")
}
```

### Co-located pairs

```{r}
#| label: co-located-pairs
#| eval: true

co_loc <- od |> filter(co_located)
if (nrow(co_loc) > 0) {
  co_loc |>
    select(network, dps, chef_lieu, sentinel_site, dps_basis, straight_line_km) |>
    mutate(straight_line_km = round(straight_line_km, 2)) |>
    kable(caption = "Pairs under 1 km apart")
} else {
  cat("No co-located pairs.\n")
}
```

### All pairs

```{r}
#| label: all-pairs
#| eval: true

od |>
  transmute(
    network, dps, sentinel_site,
    dps_lat = round(dps_lat, 4), dps_lon = round(dps_lon, 4),
    site_lat = round(site_lat, 4), site_lon = round(site_lon, 4),
    km = round(straight_line_km, 1), dps_basis
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "DPS–site pairs")
```

## Map

```{r}
#| label: pairs-map
#| eval: true
#| fig-cap: "DPS headquarters and sentinel sites, joined by pair."

lines <- od |> filter(complete)

map <- leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = dps_final |> filter(!is.na(latitude)),
    lng = ~longitude, lat = ~latitude, group = "DPS",
    color = "#b2182b", radius = 7, fillOpacity = 0.8,
    label = ~dps,
    popup = ~paste0("<b>", dps, "</b><br>",
                    "<b>Chef-lieu:</b> ", chef_lieu, "<br>",
                    "<b>Basis:</b> ", point_basis, "<br>",
                    "<b>Confidence:</b> ", confidence, "<br>",
                    "<b>Matched address:</b> ", matched_address)
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = sites |> filter(!is.na(latitude)),
    lng = ~longitude, lat = ~latitude, group = "Sentinel sites",
    color = "#2166ac", radius = 5, fillOpacity = 0.8,
    label = ~sentinel_site,
    popup = ~paste0("<b>", sentinel_site, "</b><br>",
                    "<b>Province:</b> ", province, "<br>",
                    "<b>Confidence:</b> ", confidence)
  )

for (i in seq_len(nrow(lines))) {
  map <- map |>
    addPolylines(lng = c(lines$dps_lon[i], lines$site_lon[i]),
                 lat = c(lines$dps_lat[i], lines$site_lat[i]),
                 color = "#4d4d4d", weight = 2, opacity = 0.7, group = "Pairs",
                 label = paste0(lines$dps[i], " → ", lines$sentinel_site[i], ": ",
                                round(lines$straight_line_km[i], 1), " km"))
}

map <- map |>
  addLayersControl(overlayGroups = c("DPS", "Sentinel sites", "Pairs"),
                   options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE))

# Build in a temp directory: saveWidget() leaves a scratch "*_files" folder
# beside its target even when the result is fully self-contained.
staged <- file.path(tempdir(), "drc_dps_site_pairs_map.html")
saveWidget(map, staged, selfcontained = TRUE)
file.copy(staged, file.path(paths$output, "drc_dps_site_pairs_map.html"), overwrite = TRUE)

map
```

## Extending to Other Networks

A network is a set of rows in `../input/drc_dps_site_pairs.csv`, tagged with
its `network`. Both of its points must be in a registry first.

- **2003–2005 (11 sites).** All 11 original sites are already among the 26.
  Add the 11 pre-2015 DPS to `drc_dps_26.csv`, for example
  `DPS Bandundu, Kwilu, Bandundu`. The DPS name keeps the old province, and
  `province` gives the current province its seat lies in. Every pre-2015 DPS
  seat is also a current chef-lieu. Then add the 11 pair rows.
- **2021 (25 sites).** Add the new sites to the sentinel input and re-render
  `drc-geocoding-workflow.qmd`. The DPS are the same 26. Then add the pair rows.
  If a pair names a site that has not been geocoded, the build stops and lists
  it.

## Output Files

| File | Description |
|:-------------------------------|:-----------------------------------------|
| `drc_dps_site_pairs.csv` | One row per pair: both coordinates, provenance, straight-line km and flags |
| `drc_dps_geocoded.csv` | DPS input columns plus coordinates, basis and review reason |
| `drc_dps_candidates.csv` | Every DPS candidate at every rung, accepted or rejected |
| `drc_dps_review.csv` | DPS to check by hand |
| `drc_dps_site_pairs_map.html` | Interactive map of the pairs |

All outputs are git-ignored. Google's terms allow only limited caching of
geocoding results.
